title: GravityShift
description:
Bend the laws of physics in Minecraft! 🌍
GravityShift allows you to modify player gravity for unique, fun, and chaotic gameplay.

 Change gravity effects 
 Create insane challenges
 Perfect for mini-games & experiments

Designed for Spigot/Paper servers
body:
Take full control of gravity in Minecraft! 🚀

This custom Gravity Plugin allows you to modify how gravity affects players using a simple command.

Command:
✔ /gravity – Change the player’s gravity effect

Perfect for:

✔ Mini-games
✔ Challenges
✔ Fun servers
✔ Trolling friends 😈

Lightweight, simple, and designed for modern Spigot / Paper / Purpur servers.
